content: KAUN-O Kadeikada Israel pwehki Tiahk en Pwongih Dikedik en Eni
KAUN-O ketin mahsanih, “Kumwail peuk sowi! Imwintihti kan pipihrdohng nan sapweiet rasehng ikel kan! Nei aramas akan kauwelahr inou me I wiahiongirailehr oh kahngohdiong ei padahk kan.
Mehndahte ar wiahkin ie ar Koht oh kin nda me nei aramas irail oh me dene re ese ie,
re keselahr dahme pwung. Pwehki met ar imwintihti kan pahn pwakihirail.

“Nei aramas akan kin pilada ar nanmwarki, ahpw pein irail me kin pilada. Re kin kasapwilada kaun akan, ahpw kaidehn ngehi me kamanahla. Re kin ale neirail kohl oh silper oh wiahkihda dikedik en eni—mehn kamwomwala pein irail.
I kalahdeki kouwol kohl me mehn Sameria kan kin pwongih. I uhdahn engieng kowahlap pahrail. Ia erein ar pahn wiewia ar tiahk en pwongih kouwol kohlo?
Sounsuk mete kan en Israel me wiahda kouwolo, oh kaidehn koht emen mwo! Kouwol kohl me kaudok kin wiawihong nan Sameria pahn kamweremweredi!
Ma re padok kisinieng, re pahn dolung melimel! Mwetin wihd ehu me sohte wa sohte pahn kak kihda pilawa. Ahpw ma e pil kihda pilawa, mehn liki kan pahn kangasang.
Israel duwelahr wehi teikan oh pil solahr katepe duwehte einpwoat ohla ieu.
Mehn Israel kin wiewia pein nsenarail, rasehng keptakai en ahs lawalo. Re repen sawas rehn mehn Asiria oh pwainohng wehi teikan en sinsile irail.
Ahpw met I pahn ketikinirailpene oh kaloke irail. Re pahn mwadangete kosokoskiseli medek ni ahnsou me nanmwarkien Asiria pahn kaloke irail.
“Uwen tohtohn pei sarawi me mehn Israel kan kauwada mehn lapwahda diparail kan, iei pil duwen tohtohlahn wasahn arail wiewia ie dihp!
I ntingihedi padahk tohtohie ong aramas akan, ahpw re soikala wiahki mehkot me re sahn oh en mehn liki.

Re kin wiahiong ie meirong oh kin kangala uduk en meirong kan. Ahpw ngehi, KAUN-O, I sohte kupwurperenkin irail, oh met I pahn kupwukupwurehte diparail oh kalokehkin irail; I pahn kapwureiraillahng nan Isip!

“Mehn Israel kan kauwadahr tehnpas kei, ahpw re manokelahr Sounkapikiraildao. Mehn Suda kauwadahr kahnimw kei me kehl kehlail. Ahpw I pahn kadarodo kisiniei me pahn isikedi tehnpesen nanmwarki kan oh arail kahnimw kan.”
